sources: https://admissions.ucc.edu.gh/catalogue/programme/<programme-slug> (535 programme pages; each programme entry carries its own url)
notes: UCC has 5 colleges (academics.ucc.edu.gh/colleges). The School of Graduate Studies (sgs.ucc.edu.gh) administers postgraduate admissions but is not a teaching college; postgraduate programmes are listed under their owning departments.

Programme-to-department attribution follows the official admissions catalogue, which has some odd attributions (e.g. BSc Agricultural Economics under Animal Science, MB ChB under Anatomy, BSc Sport Science and MSc Molecular Biology under the IEPA "Academic Programmes" unit). Near-duplicate catalogue entries (e.g. BSc Agricultural Extension / Agriculture Extension) are kept as published.
School placement of departments whose catalogue parent was missing (engineering, law, optometry, medical imaging/lab science) is taken from the college/school websites.
"University-wide Institutes and Units" is a grouping created here for catalogue units not under a college; short code UNI is not an official UCC abbreviation.
durationYears is null where the catalogue does not state it; for multi-entry programmes (e.g. top-up routes) the longest duration is given.
Courses come from the catalogue semester schedules (main WASSCE/degree-entry route). Postgraduate courses use levels 800/900.
